# Emirates Front Contracting Company (شركة واجهة الامارات للمقاولات)

> General Contracting, Building Envelope & Façade Engineering, Civil Superstructures, and MEP Solutions in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

## Organization Summary
- **Entity Name (EN):** Emirates Front Contracting Company
- **Entity Name (AR):** شركة واجهة الامارات للمقاولات
- **Location:** Riyadh, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia
- **Primary Contact / WhatsApp:** +966 59 014 6337
- **Official Email:** emiratesfront@gmail.com
- **Core Positioning:** General Contracting with specialized prominence in Building Envelopes, Curtain Walls, and Architectural Cladding (reflecting the Arabic name واجهة).

## Core Capabilities & Services
1. **Building Envelope & Façade:** Unitized & Stick Curtain Walls, Spider Glass Façade Systems, Fire-Rated Aluminum Composite Panels (ACP), and Waterproofing/Thermal Insulation.
2. **Civil & Structural:** Turnkey General Contracting, Reinforced Concrete Footings & Superstructures, Insulated Masonry & Block Work, and Structural Renovations.
3. **MEP Engineering:** HVAC Central Plants, Low-Voltage Electrical Distribution Panels, Low-Current Cabling, Water Supply & Silent Drainage Networks, and SMACNA Ducting.
4. **Finishing & Turnkey Fit-Out:** False Ceilings, Drywall Partitions, Architectural Coatings & Epoxies, Natural Marble & Large Porcelain Tile Flooring, and Corporate Office Fit-outs.
5. **Earthworks & Site Logistics:** Bulk Deep Excavation, Hydraulic Rock Breaking, Laser Grading & Compaction, and Hoarding Setup.
6. **Industrial & Steel Structures:** Pre-Engineered Steel Buildings (PEB), Industrial Warehouse Construction, and Civil Facility Maintenance.

## Standards & Compliance
- Full adherence to the Saudi Building Code (SBC) and SASO standards.
- Ministry of Commerce (KSA) and ZATCA compliance frameworks.
- WhatsApp-first rapid estimating and project evaluation workflow.
